title: Concept
description: A single concept node. Every concept must be able to answer the 10-question contract (see issue via-decide/kup-curriculum#17) before it is promoted past DISCOVERED. A concept with every field present but no real sourceRefs is a hollow entry, not a completed one -- see tests/graph-integrity.test.mjs.

depthState.description: Spiral progression state, not a binary done/not-done flag. A concept can be revisited at higher depth as projects require it.

domainRefs.description: domainId values this concept belongs to. Must resolve to real entries in curriculum/graph.yaml.

problemItRepresents.description: Question 2: what problem created the need for this representation?

physicalMeaning.description: Question 4: what each term physically means. Empty string allowed only while depthState is DISCOVERED.

bridges.description: bridgeId values connecting this concept to other domains (question 7).

simulation.description: Question 8. artifactRef must point to a real committed artifact once depthState is SIMULATED or beyond -- a feasible:true with no artifactRef past that point is a hollow claim.

claimStatus.description: No claim may be ESTABLISHED merely because it appears in the curriculum -- acceptance criterion in issue #17. ESTABLISHED requires sourceRefs pointing to evidence outside this repo.

failureBoundary.description: Question 6: where does the model break?

sourceRefs.description: sourceId values from sources/free-source-shelf.yaml. A concept past DISCOVERED with zero sourceRefs is exactly the 'AI-generated pseudo-knowledge' failure mode named in issue #17 and must fail graph-integrity tests.
